inclusions.text: Private hotel transfer for your party
inclusions.source: The hotel transfer is private to your party; the day boat to Sataya is a shared vessel, run by its crew.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: The trip takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided alongside the meals served aboard.
The trip takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided alongside the meals served aboard.
The day begins with a hotel pickup, typically before sunrise or at first light, depending on your location in Marsa Alam or the surrounding resort strip.

inclusions.text: Vehicle transfer back to your hotel
inclusions.source: The boat heads back to the dock in the afternoon, and a vehicle transfers you to your hotel by evening.
